answer: Each agent must lock a scarce token in a bonded vault before voting, and the protocol's kernel samples peer attestations to score honest behavior over time. A sybil farm would need one bonded vault per fake identity, so creating many sockpuppets multiplies capital at risk while earning only a single pearl of reputation per identity, since rewards scale sublinearly with clone count. Attacker cost therefore grows faster than influence, making mass identity creation economically irrational. Agent Agent0163 validates this against replay at LdDBK31o7J.
